descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S13 Existing specs: what reaches the next day without an import (the one-line summary card and yesterday's bedside transcript)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Day-2 reopen (Hospital, 20 h): yesterday's encounter and note are gone from the working tabs (18 h). They are still present as yesterday's transcript and, read-only, as the previous note until the wi … (UAT TC-13; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1; TFA-94699 table (Encounter, note)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U12 A one-line summary from today's finished note appears in tomorrow's pre-round with no upload, paste or photo step. It contains nothing the note did not say and appears on that patient only. (UAT TC-13; UAT 3.4; TFA-92591 AC 5; TFA-92591 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: State transition (state-transition) — Go through the steps in order (add → edit → delete, day 1 → day 2, offline → online) and check the state after each step.

Given Tim's fixtures: a Hospital patient with note generation and course refresh mocked, and a Hospital patient whose live transcript is dated the previous day (seeded transcriptDate)

When Dictate, Generate Note & Finish, open Pre-Round. On the other patient, start and stop a new bedside recording today, then Generate (mocked)

Then 'Carried Forward from Last Finished Note' shows the generated one-line summary, stored as nextPreRoundSummary, with no import step. Yesterday's lines are archived and listed as '<date> (prior)', today's line is the live transcript, and a same-day write does not archive again

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in encounter-workflow.spec.ts and prior-transcripts.spec.ts; passes only if both pass. This covers the same day and a calendar-day change only. The summary still being there tomorrow, the typed encounter, the 18 h window and the previous note are covered in S12 and S15

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Test issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92591 in progress; TFA-94699 in progress

Nothing is wrong for the physician: Tim's two specs still press Generate and wait for tasks, but since 7f3907f a single Stop generates the note automatically and the transcript is hidden while recording.

Evidence: allure 93b5031b, marked test out of date (local). encounter-workflow.spec.ts times out, and prior-transcripts.spec.ts cannot see the live line. Bisected over 7f3907f^, 5d83248^ and 5d83248: no regression. Two physician-visible changes should be confirmed with Tim / Daniela: auto-generate on Stop with the transcript hidden while recording (7f3907f), and no task extraction after Generate (726f724).

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-13 Previous Notes · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-13/S13

Existing specs: what reaches the next day without an import (the one-line summary card and yesterday's bedside transcript)

Tickets: TFA-92591 Previous Notes (carry-forward template) (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

Result: failed in matrix/TC-13.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Test out of date (local) — the test is out of date, the product is right; not a product failure.

  • encounter-workflow.spec.ts:156: The same "one Stop generates the note" change (7f3907f, EncounterTab.tsx:84), plus Vikram's 726f724 (09-24), which stopped deriving tasks after Generate; the test still follows the old flow (click Generate, wait for tasks).
  • prior-transcripts.spec.ts:161: Tim's 7f3907f (10-12) hides the transcript while recording (EncounterTab.tsx:60-63) and generates the note on a single Stop (EncounterTab.tsx:84); the test still looks for the line during the recording. These are two changes a physician sees; to confirm with Tim / Daniela.

Bisected on an isolated stack over 7f3907f^, 5d83248^ and 5d83248: 5d83248 brought no regression.

Existing specs:

  • encounter-workflow.spec.ts [chromium] — Generate Note transitions with the dictated source attached — unexpected
  • prior-transcripts.spec.ts [chromium] — a new day's bedside recording archives yesterday's transcript instead of overwriting it — unexpected

Failure screenshots and page snapshots are on the failing steps. Videos stay in matrix/TC-13-artifacts/ (not attached).

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's Playwright specs e2e/encounter-workflow.spec.ts and e2e/prior-transcripts.spec.ts, chromium): they make fresh @roundai.test accounts, seed charts (a previous-day transcriptDate) through e2e/support/backend.ts with the local admin key, and mock note generation and the course refresh …. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
